stemMd: A crate remains at rest on a horizontal floor while a 12 N horizontal push acts on it. What is the magnitude of static friction, assuming no other horizontal forces?
explanationMd: Rest implies zero net horizontal force. Static friction therefore balances the 12 N push. It need not equal its maximum allowed value unless impending motion is reached.

distractorRationale.d: Static friction adjusts up to its maximum.
distractorRationale.a: Weight does not directly equal the actual horizontal friction.
distractorRationale.c: This doubles the force rather than balancing it.
distractorRationale.e: The push would otherwise cause acceleration.
